scope: Authored physical-field microbenchmarks on aarch64 macOS with Cranelift JIT; not a whole-program or Tecs snapshot speedup.

method.ordering: Alternating baseline/candidate order, serial fresh process pairs for each workload. All results and source assertions checked.
method.primaryMetric: Per-process median warm-call monotonic wall milliseconds; runner cpu_now uses std::time::Instant, not CPU time.
method.interval: 95 percent paired bootstrap interval of geometric-mean baseline/candidate ratios across seven process pairs; 10000 deterministic resamples.
method.secondaryMetric: Peak RSS from per-child wait4; unchanged within 5 percent for all four cases in both comparisons.
method.hostActivity: No concurrent task compiler, build, or test jobs during final runs. macOS background activity remained uncontrolled: fseventsd around one core, WindowServer and other system processes active. Results are local measurements, not an idle-host guarantee.
method.metricCorrection: Earlier pilot labels said CPU time. Only their labels were corrected after inspecting runner cpu_now; raw timing samples were not changed.

deterministicEvidence.native: Candidate scalar assembly contains direct AArch64 ldr/str of d/s registers after the nonallocating guard; miss edges retain generic helpers. Layout facts come from checked semantic types.
deterministicEvidence.allocationInterpretation: Image-only comparison leaves object counts unchanged. Whole-change comparison adds two setup objects per case. No removal of wide boxes or row-view materialization is claimed.
